item.title: Germany cuts energy tax to lower petrol prices as Merz faces state key elections
item.description:
German Chancellor Friedrich Merz faced growing pressure on his leadership ahead of state elections in which polls suggest his governing party will fare badly. In one region, his CDU party is barely above the threshold required to enter the state assembly, and it faces the prospect of falling to second in the capital , too.
